n83b470bf61f.s: Under the POCSO Act, 2012, a 'child' means any person below the age of:
n83b470bf61f.x: POCSO treats every person below 18 years as a child, in a gender-neutral manner.

nindian-society-40-13.s: Under the Juvenile Justice Act, 2015, children aged 16–18 may be tried as adults only when accused of:
o: Any offence punishable with fine only
nindian-society-40-13.x: The JJ Act, 2015 lets 16–18-year-olds be tried as adults only for heinous offences.

ndd98c4e2150.s: Under the Juvenile Justice Act, 2015, a Child in Need of Care and Protection is dealt with by the:
ndd98c4e2150.x: A Child in Need of Care and Protection goes to the Child Welfare Committee; a Child in Conflict with Law goes to the Juvenile Justice Board.

ndee9e8befc8.s: The Children's Court, which tries cases transferred by the Juvenile Justice Board, is a:
o: Court of the Judicial Magistrate First Class
ndee9e8befc8.x: The Children's Court is a Sessions Court that tries cases transferred to it; the Board handles children in conflict with law.

nindian-society-40-24.s: The Right to Education Act, 2009 gives effect to which Article of the Constitution?
nindian-society-40-24.x: The RTE Act, 2009 puts Article 21A into effect by giving free and compulsory education to children aged 6–14.

nb5690cc9703.s: Which provisions of the POCSO Act place the burden of proof on the accused?
nb5690cc9703.x: Sections 29–30 raise a presumption against the accused; Section 19 is mandatory reporting and Section 22 is false complaints.

n205af3cfd1b.s: The Supreme Court set aside which High Court's ruling that had excluded consensual adolescent relationships from POCSO?
n205af3cfd1b.x: The Supreme Court set aside the Calcutta High Court ruling; it did not itself exclude such relationships from POCSO.

nindian-society-49-10.s: The 2019 amendment to the POCSO Act added which punishment for aggravated penetrative sexual assault?
nindian-society-49-10.x: The 2019 amendment added the death penalty for aggravated penetrative sexual assault.

n5138cb18960.s: According to the Study on Child Abuse: India 2007, what share of abusers were known to the child or in a position of trust?
n5138cb18960.x: The 2007 study found over 50% of abusers known to the child or in trust; 97.1% is the NCRB 2021 figure for offenders.

n6aeb293365d.s: After the 2016 amendment, children below 14 years are barred from employment in:
o: All occupations and processes, with specified exceptions
n6aeb293365d.x: Since 2016, children below 14 are banned from all occupations and processes, subject to specified exceptions.

n9cffc1dd8aa.s: The original Child Labour Act, 1986 banned children below 14 from how many occupations and processes?
n9cffc1dd8aa.x: The 1986 Act listed 18 prohibited occupations and 65 prohibited processes for children below 14.

n767e2d911fc.s: The child-artist exception in the Child Labour Amendment Act, 2016 does NOT extend to work in:
n767e2d911fc.x: Child artists may work in audio-visual entertainment if schooling is not affected, but circus is excluded.

n45610f1a067.s: The 'adolescent' category created by the 2016 child labour amendment covers persons aged:
n45610f1a067.x: Adolescents are 14–18 and are barred only from hazardous occupations and processes.

nindian-society-40-14.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Child and Adolescent Labour Act, as amended in 2016?
o: It bars children below 14 from all occupations, except family-enterprise help after school
It bars adolescents aged 14–18 from hazardous occupations and processes
It permits children below 14 to work in non-hazardous occupations
It created a separate category of adolescents aged 14–18
nindian-society-40-14.x: Children below 14 are barred from all occupations, the only exception being family-enterprise help after school; so they cannot work in non-hazardous occupations.

nb1303ffaea7.s: In M.C. Mehta v. State of Tamil Nadu, the offending employer had to deposit how much per child in the Child Labour Rehabilitation-cum-Welfare Fund?
nb1303ffaea7.x: The employer was directed to deposit ₹20,000 for each child into the Child Labour Rehabilitation-cum-Welfare Fund.

n9669fb4c7cf.s: The Mines Act, 1952 prohibits employment in mines of anyone below the age of:
n9669fb4c7cf.x: The Mines Act, 1952 bars anyone below 18; the Factories Act, 1948 bars children below 14.

n0bfe2b6edcd.s: One Nation One Anganwadi mainly lets which group keep ICDS benefits?
o: Adolescent girls in the North-East only
Families holding a child's Aadhaar only
Migrant families moving to another State
n0bfe2b6edcd.x: It lets migrant families keep ICDS benefits for children below six and pregnant/lactating women in another State; child Aadhaar is not mandatory.

n769fafa03bb.s: Poshan Pakhwada is a nutrition campaign lasting:
n769fafa03bb.x: Poshan Pakhwada is a fortnight-long campaign; its 8th edition (2026) focused on brain development in the first six years.

nbc0c2e9851b.s: Besides better nutrition, PM POSHAN aims to tackle:
nbc0c2e9851b.x: PM POSHAN aims to address classroom hunger and raise enrolment, attendance, retention and concentration.

na94ff47d339.s: The nodal ministry for Beti Bachao Beti Padhao is the:
o: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
Ministry of Women and Child Development
na94ff47d339.x: MWCD is nodal for BBBP, working with Health and Education; the Finance Ministry runs Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana.

nb20efbffdfa.s: Saksham Anganwadi and Poshan 2.0 was introduced in:
nb20efbffdfa.x: Saksham Anganwadi and Poshan 2.0 began in 2021 under MWCD as a Centrally Sponsored Scheme.

n88630933a12.s: Under Saksham Anganwadi and Poshan 2.0, the Centre-State funding ratio for North-Eastern and Himalayan States and J&K is:
n88630933a12.x: NE and Himalayan States and J&K get 90:10; general States 60:40; UTs without legislature are 100% Centre.

n1111a9f3b95.s: POSHAN Abhiyaan set a goal of reducing stunting to ____ by 2022.
n1111a9f3b95.x: POSHAN Abhiyaan aimed to reduce stunting to 25% by 2022, as part of a Jan Andolan for a Suposhit Bharat.

nf2dd862d2bc.x: Poshan Vatikas are nutrition gardens at Anganwadi centres; play-based ECCE is Poshan Bhi Padhai Bhi.

n4386cc4f9f6.s: PM POSHAN covers children studying in:
o: Bal Vatika and Classes I to VIII
n4386cc4f9f6.x: PM POSHAN gives one hot cooked meal to Bal Vatika and Classes I–VIII in government and aided schools.

n2d48f996bd1.s: Under PM POSHAN, the nutritional norm per child at the primary level is:
n2d48f996bd1.x: Primary: 450 kcal and 12 g protein; upper primary: 700 kcal and 20 g protein.

nindian-society-50-16.s: The Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016 came into force on:
nindian-society-50-16.x: The RPwD Act was passed in 2016 and came into force on 19 April 2017.

n9581ba7b110.s: The rights-based RPwD Act, 2016 replaced which welfare-based law?
o: PwD (Equal Opportunities, Protection of Rights and Full Participation) Act, 1995
n9581ba7b110.x: The 2016 Act replaced the welfare-based PwD Act, 1995 with a rights-based framework.

n5fb616849f8.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the UNCRPD?
o: The UN General Assembly adopted it on 13 December 2006
India has ratified its Optional Protocol
Its Optional Protocol provides an individual complaints mechanism
n5fb616849f8.x: The Optional Protocol provides individual complaints, but India has not ratified it.

nindian-society-35-19.s: The Accessible India Campaign is also known as:
nindian-society-35-19.x: The Accessible India Campaign is Sugamya Bharat Abhiyan; UDID comes under Social Justice and Empowerment.

nindian-society-37-4.s: School-based screening of children for 21 disabilities is done through the:
nindian-society-37-4.x: PRASHAST is the screening app; the Sugamya Bharat App takes accessibility complaints.

nindian-society-37-37.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about disability portals and apps?
o: The UDID Portal comes under DEPwD
The PM-DAKSH Portal comes under DEPwD
The PRASHAST App comes under DEPwD
The Accessible India Campaign is a DEPwD flagship
nindian-society-37-37.x: PRASHAST comes under Education (NCERT/DoSEL), not DEPwD; UDID and PM-DAKSH are DEPwD.

nindian-society-35-33.s: Which initiative provides a national centralised database and a single identity card for persons with disabilities?
nindian-society-35-33.x: UDID gives one national database and ID card for disability benefits; ADIP gives free assistive devices.

na7adf044999.s: Which case dealt with the deplaning of a woman with cerebral palsy and her right to dignity?
o: Rajive Raturi v. Union of India
Jeeja Ghosh v. Union of India
na7adf044999.x: Jeeja Ghosh concerned deplaning and dignity; mandatory accessibility standards were the issue in Rajive Raturi.

nindian-society-45-14.s: Rajive Raturi v. Union of India is associated with:
o: Time-bound accessibility directions for public transport and buildings
Deplaning of a passenger with cerebral palsy
nindian-society-45-14.x: Rajive Raturi gave time-bound accessibility directions for built infrastructure and public transport, not limited to any one kind of institution.

n3cd0f077c8b.s: According to Census 2011, persons with disabilities formed what share of India's population?
n3cd0f077c8b.x: Census 2011 put it at 2.21%, against a global estimate of about 16%, suggesting under-reporting.

nindian-society-37-5.s: The PM-DAKSH Portal for Divyangjan comes under which ministry?
o: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
nindian-society-37-5.x: PM-DAKSH, for skilling, training and job listings for Divyangjan, comes under Social Justice and Empowerment, not Minority Affairs.

new.s: Which Article bars employment of children below 14 in factories, mines and hazardous employment?
new.x: Article 24 bars children below 14 from factories, mines and hazardous employment.

new.s: Which Article directs that the tender age of children is not abused?
new.x: Article 39(e) covers tender age not being abused; 39(f) covers exploitation and moral and material abandonment.

new.s: The National Policy for Children, 2013 treats as a child every person below:
new.x: NPC 2013 treats everyone below 18 as a child and puts best interests first.

new.s: The Juvenile Justice Act, 1986 fixed the juvenile age for boys and girls respectively at:
new.x: The 1986 Act, the first uniform juvenile law, set 16 for boys and 18 for girls; the 2000 Act made it 18 for all.

new.s: The Children Act, 1960 was enacted for:
new.x: The Children Act, 1960 applied to the Union Territories.

new.s: Under the Juvenile Justice Act, 2015, a Child Welfare Committee has a Chairperson and how many members?
new.x: A CWC has a Chairperson and 4 members; a JJB has a Principal Magistrate and 2 social workers.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the preliminary assessment under the Juvenile Justice Act, 2015?
o: It applies to 16–18-year-olds accused of heinous offences
It is made by the Juvenile Justice Board
It may lead to transfer of the case to the Children's Court
It amounts to a finding of guilt
new.x: The preliminary assessment is not a finding of guilt; it only decides whether the case may go to the Children's Court.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the Juvenile Justice Act, 2015:
1. It came into force on 15 January 2016.
2. Its 2021 amendment came into force on 1 September 2022.
3. Every district has a Juvenile Justice Board and a Child Welfare Committee.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: All three are correct: in force 15 Jan 2016, 2021 amendment in force 1 Sept 2022, and a JJB and CWC in every district.

new.s: Under the 2019 POCSO amendment, the minimum punishment for aggravated penetrative sexual assault is:
new.x: Since 2019 the minimum is 20 years for aggravated and 10 years for penetrative sexual assault.

new.s: Under Section 19 of the POCSO Act, failure to report an offence is punishable with imprisonment up to:
new.x: Section 19 makes reporting mandatory; failure attracts up to 6 months and/or fine.

new.s: Which body's 283rd Report (2023) warned that lowering the age of consent would make POCSO a 'paper law'?
new.x: The Law Commission's 283rd Report (2023) opposed lowering the age, calling it a route to a 'paper law'.

new.s: The Justice Verma Committee wanted the age of consent fixed at:
new.x: The Justice Verma Committee wanted 16; POCSO 2012 and CLA 2013 kept 18.

new.s: The IPC amendment of 1925 raised the age of consent to:
new.x: The age was 10 under the IPC of 1860, 12 under the 1891 Act, 14 after the 1925 amendment and 18 under POCSO.

new.s: According to NCRB 2023 data, which State had the highest rate of crimes against children?
new.x: Assam had the highest rate (84.2); Madhya Pradesh had the highest number of cases.

new.s: According to NCRB 2023 data, which State recorded the highest number of crimes against children?
new.x: Madhya Pradesh had the most cases, followed by Maharashtra and UP; Assam had the highest rate.

new.s: The Study on Child Abuse: India 2007 by MWCD covered about 12,447 children in how many States?
new.x: The 2007 study covered 13 States and about 12,447 children.

new.s: According to the Study on Child Abuse: India 2007, what percentage of children reported sexual abuse?
new.x: 53.22% reported sexual abuse; two out of three faced physical abuse.

new.s: Reported cases of online child sexual abuse material (CSAM) in India in 2023 exceeded:
new.x: Over 4.5 lakh CSAM cases were reported in 2023; IT Rules 2021 require large platforms to detect it automatically.

new.s: After the 2016 amendment, the Child Labour (Prohibition and Regulation) Act is called the:
o: Child and Adolescent Labour (Prohibition and Regulation) Act
new.x: The 2016 amendment renamed it the Child and Adolescent Labour (Prohibition and Regulation) Act.

new.s: Under the amended child labour law, employing a child is punishable with imprisonment of:
new.x: Offences are cognizable, with 6 months to 2 years and/or a fine of ₹20,000–50,000.

new.s: Which fund was set up under the 2016 child labour amendment?
o: Child and Adolescent Labour Rehabilitation Fund
new.x: The 2016 amendment set up the Child and Adolescent Labour Rehabilitation Fund; the Rehabilitation-cum-Welfare Fund came from M.C. Mehta (1996).

new.s: According to Census 2011, how many main workers were there among child labourers aged 5–14?
new.x: Census 2011 counted 10.1 million child labourers (5–14) including marginal workers, of whom 4.35 million were main workers.

new.s: Which country has the largest number of child labourers in the world?
new.x: India has the largest number of child labourers, driven by poverty, demand for cheap labour and debt bondage.

new.s: CHILDLINE, which is integrated with ERSS-112, uses the helpline number:
new.x: CHILDLINE 1098 is integrated with the Emergency Response Support System 112.

new.s: The PENCIL portal for child labour enforcement was launched in:
new.x: PENCIL was launched in 2017 by the Ministry of Labour and Employment.

new.s: Besides the JJ Act, 2015, Andhra Pradesh's juvenile justice system follows which law?
new.x: AP follows the JJ Act, 2015 along with the Probation of Offenders Act, 1958; its JJBs are headed by a female Principal Magistrate.

new.s: The NCPCR was set up in 2007 under which Act?
o: Commissions for Protection of Child Rights Act, 2005
new.x: NCPCR is a statutory body set up in 2007 under the CPCR Act, 2005; it monitors POCSO, JJ and RTE.

new.s: Mission Vatsalya (2021-22 to 2025-26) is funded by the Centre and States in the ratio:
new.x: Mission Vatsalya, with an outlay of ₹10,916 crore, is shared 60:40.

new.s: India ratified ILO Conventions 138 and 182 on:
new.x: India ratified both conventions on 13 June 2017; 12 June is World Day Against Child Labour.

new.s: Which case dealt with trafficking, child begging and circus children, with oversight of child care institutions?
o: M.C. Mehta v. State of Tamil Nadu (1996)
Independent Thought v. Union of India (2017)
new.x: Bachpan Bachao Andolan (2011) covered trafficking, child begging and circus children.

new.s: M.C. Mehta v. State of Tamil Nadu (1996) arose from child labour in:
new.x: The case concerned Sivakasi and banned child labour in hazardous industries.

new.s: The Integrated Child Development Services (ICDS) scheme was launched on:
new.x: ICDS was launched on 2 October 1975 and universalised in 2006.

new.s: The nodal ministry for ICDS is the:
o: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
Ministry of Women and Child Development
new.x: ICDS is run by MWCD; PM POSHAN is under the Ministry of Education.

new.s: Rashtriya Poshan Maah is observed every year in:
new.x: Poshan Maah is in September; Poshan Pakhwada is a fortnight in March–April.

new.s: The 9th Rashtriya Poshan Maah (2026) was held at:
new.x: The 9th Poshan Maah (2026) was at Varanasi; POSHAN Abhiyaan began at Jhunjhunu and BBBP at Panipat.

new.s: The National Early Childhood Care and Education (ECCE) Policy was adopted in:
new.x: The National ECCE Policy dates from 2013; NEP 2020 created the foundational stage.

new.s: Which State first introduced the mid-day meal?
new.x: Tamil Nadu was first with the mid-day meal; Gujarat was first with Tithi Bhojan.

new.s: The Mid-Day Meal Scheme was renamed PM POSHAN in:
new.x: It was renamed PM POSHAN (Pradhan Mantri Poshan Shakti Nirman) in 2021.

new.s: In 2024-25, Andhra Pradesh's Dokka Seethamma Mid-Day Meal was extended to:
new.x: AP extended the Dokka Seethamma Mid-Day Meal to Intermediate (Classes 11–12) in 2024-25.

new.s: According to NFHS-5 (2019-21), stunting among children under five in India is:
new.x: Stunting fell from 38.4% (NFHS-4) to 35.5% (NFHS-5); 19.3% is wasting and 32.1% underweight.

new.s: In the Global Hunger Index 2025, India ranked:
new.x: India was 102nd of 123 (score 25.8, 'serious') in 2025, up from 105th in 2024.

new.s: According to NFHS-5, anaemia among women aged 15–49 is:
new.x: Anaemia in women aged 15–49 is 57.0% in NFHS-5.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about NFHS-5 (2019-21) indicators for children under five:
1. Wasting in India is 19.3%.
2. Underweight in Andhra Pradesh is higher than the national figure.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Statement 1 is correct. Statement 2 is wrong: AP underweight is 29.6% against India's 32.1%.

new.s: Under Janani Suraksha Yojana, the cash assistance for institutional delivery in rural areas is:
new.x: JSY gives ₹1,400 in rural and ₹1,000 in urban areas; ₹500 is for home delivery for BPL women.

new.s: Pradhan Mantri Surakshit Matritva Abhiyan (PMSMA) was launched in:
new.x: PMSMA began in 2016 under MoHFW; JSY is 2005, JSSK 2011 and PMMVY 2017.

new.s: Dhanalakshmi, a pilot conditional cash transfer for the girl child, was launched in:
new.x: Dhanalakshmi began in 2008; Balika Samriddhi Yojana dates from 1997.

new.s: Under the Prohibition of Child Marriage Act, 2006, Child Marriage Prohibition Officers are appointed by:
new.x: Child Marriage Prohibition Officers are appointed by State Governments.

new.s: According to NFHS-5, which State has the highest share of women aged 20–24 married before 18?
new.x: NFHS-5 shows 23.3% nationally, with West Bengal the highest.

new.s: Aftercare support under Mission Vatsalya covers young persons aged:
new.x: Aftercare covers 18–21 (extendable to 23) at ₹4,000 a month.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about child support schemes:
1. Under Mission Vatsalya, sponsorship and foster care support is ₹4,000 per child per month.
2. Palna creches are open only to children of employed mothers.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Statement 1 is correct. Statement 2 is wrong: Palna is open whether or not the mother is employed.

new.s: Shakti Sadan under Mission Shakti – Samarthya combines which two schemes?
new.x: Shakti Sadan merges Ujjawala and Swadhar; Palna and PMMVY are separate Samarthya components.

new.s: Rashtriya Mahila Kosh, set up in 1993, provides:
o: Shelter for women in difficult circumstances
Micro-credit to poor women without collateral
new.x: RMK gives collateral-free micro-credit to poor women in the informal sector.

new.s: The Ujjawala scheme of the Ministry of Women and Child Development deals with:
new.x: Ujjawala is about trafficking; PM Ujjwala Yojana (MoPNG) gives LPG connections.

new.s: YSR Sampoorna Poshana in Andhra Pradesh was launched on:
new.x: It was launched on 7 Sept 2020 for pregnant and lactating women and children 6–72 months.

new.s: Balamrutham in Andhra Pradesh provides take-home ration to children aged:
new.x: Balamrutham is take-home ration for children 6 months–3 years.

new.s: YSR Sampoorna Poshana Plus is implemented in:
new.x: Sampoorna Poshana Plus covers 77 tribal mandals (8,320 AWCs).

new.s: Which Article of the Constitution provides for public assistance in cases of disablement?
new.x: Article 41 (DPSP) provides public assistance in disablement; Article 46 concerns weaker sections.

new.s: 'Relief of the disabled and unemployable' is which entry of the State List?
new.x: It is Entry 9 of the State List.

new.s: The National Trust Act, 1999 covers autism, cerebral palsy, mental retardation and:
new.x: The National Trust Act covers autism, cerebral palsy, mental retardation and multiple disabilities.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the RPwD Act, 2016:
1. It reserves 4% of government jobs.
2. It reserves 5% of seats in higher education.
3. Benchmark disability means at least 50% disability.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: Statements 1 and 2 are correct. Statement 3 is wrong: benchmark disability is at least 40%.

new.s: Under the RPwD Act, 2016, children with benchmark disabilities get free education between the ages of:
new.x: The RPwD Act gives free education to benchmark-disability children aged 6–18.

new.s: NIEPID, the national institute for intellectual disabilities, is located at:
new.x: NIEPID is at Secunderabad; SVNIRTAR is at Cuttack.

new.s: The DDRS scheme for persons with disabilities provides:
o: Free aids and appliances to individuals
new.x: DDRS gives grants to NGOs; ADIP gives aids to individuals.

new.s: SIPDA provides grant-in-aid for:
new.x: SIPDA is a grant-in-aid scheme to implement the RPwD Act.

new.s: EKAM Fest for Divyangjan entrepreneurs is organised by:
new.x: EKAM Fest (Entrepreneurship, Knowledge, Awareness, Marketing) is organised by NDFDC.

new.s: India's disability-sector MoU on assistive devices, approved by the Cabinet in February 2023, is with:
new.x: The South Africa MoU (Feb 2023) concerns assistive devices; the Chile MoU was approved in April 2022.

new.s: The International Day of Persons with Disabilities has been observed on 3 December since:
new.x: It has been observed since 1992; 1981 was the International Year of Disabled Persons.

new.s: According to Census 2011, Andhra Pradesh had about how many persons with disabilities?
new.x: AP had 11.04 lakh persons with disabilities in Census 2011, largely orthopaedic.

new.s: Andhra Pradesh's monthly pension for persons with disabilities is:
new.x: AP pays ₹6,000 a month.
